name: Emberborn Bloodline
description: A lineage carrying the power of ancient flame. Fire effects can generate Heat that compatible abilities interpret in different ways.

name: Shadowveil Bloodline
description: A hidden lineage connected to darkness and secrets. Shadow effects can create Veil states that reward stealth, control, and repositioning.

name: Stormborn Bloodline
description: A lineage touched by violent skies. Lightning effects can build Charge that jumps between compatible attacks.

name: Frostbound Bloodline
description: A lineage carrying ancient winter. Cold effects build Chill that can become control, cover, or defensive power.

name: Wildblood Bloodline
description: A primal inheritance that blurs the boundary between mortal and beast.

name: Crimson Bloodline
description: A dangerous lineage that turns blood, wounds, and sacrifice into usable power.

name: Dawnborn Bloodline
description: A radiant lineage tied to renewal, protection, and the first light.

name: Voidtouched Bloodline
description: A lineage exposed to the spaces between worlds. Void power trades certainty for unusual movement and spell behavior.

name: Ironblood Bloodline
description: A hardened lineage whose blood remembers battle, granting unusual resilience and momentum under pressure.

name: Spiritbound Bloodline
description: A lineage able to sense and bargain with lingering spirits, bridging the living and unseen worlds.
